three.js r128 (npm three@0.128.0), vendored for Mason on 2026-11-18 (UIFIX2 item 3).

Why: templates/mason_v2.html loaded this file from cdnjs for the 3D crystal and the background effects. It now
ships with Mason, so those work with no internet and the public repository has no CDN dependency.

Source (byte-for-byte what the page loaded before):
  https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js
How verified: the sha512 equals the value cdnjs publishes for r128 (api.cdnjs.com/libraries/three.js/r128, field
sri), and the file is byte-identical to build/three.min.js in the npm package three@0.128.0 (package integrity
sha512-i0ap/E+OaSfzw7bD1TtYnPo3VEplkl70WX5fZqZnfZsE3k3aSFudqrrC9ldFZfYFkn1zwDmBcdGfiIm/hnbyZA==, checked against
`npm view three@0.128.0 dist.integrity`).

templates/mason_v2.html.
